QuestionStmt.S: Find the number of moles present in 0.448 L of dihydrogen at STP.

Solution.S:
At STP, 1 mole of any ideal gas occupies 22.4 L.

Given: Volume of dihydrogen, $V = 0.448$ L.

Number of moles, $n = \frac{\text{Given Volume}}{\text{Molar Volume at STP}}$.

$$n = \frac{0.448}{22.4} = 0.02 \text{ mol}$$

Thus the correct option is D: 0.02 mol.
